pairs.description: Anthocyanosides in bilberry exhibit antiplatelet properties and may augment hemorrhage risks when taken alongside warfarin.
pairs.mechanism: Inhibition of platelet aggregation and thromboxane A2 release compounding anticoagulant effects.

pairs.description: Combining bilberry supplements with aspirin produces additive platelet antiaggregatory activity, prolonging bleeding time.
pairs.mechanism: Synergistic antiplatelet action through dual inhibition of cyclooxygenase and platelet cyclic AMP phosphodiesterase.

pairs.description: Bilberry leaf extract preparations possess active hypoglycemic properties that may cause additive blood glucose reductions with metformin.
pairs.mechanism: Chromium and anthocyanin-mediated stimulation of peripheral glucose oxidation and glycolysis.
